title: Incident Chronicle widget and compact handoff mode
creator: Ava Thompson
description:
Summary: Design a compact, embeddable 'Incident Chronicle' widget for Redwood Console that surfaces a chronological mini-timeline of alert activity, key SLO breaches, and direct postmortem links, plus a compact handoff mode optimized for on-call mobile use and narrow panels. This ticket covers the low-fidelity -> interactive prototype and a design review with PM/Eng/SRE.

Context: On-call engineers often need a quick chronological summary when joining an incident (e.g., during rotation changes or paging). Existing console views are full dashboard pages; we need a small, context-preserving component that can be embedded in the incident page, the on-call roster, and a mobile-friendly drawer.

Goals:
- Reduce time-to-context for an on-call engineer by surfacing the last 6 alert events, SLO trend markers (good/warning/breach), and one-click postmortem + runbook links.
- Provide a compact handoff mode with large tappable targets, summarized remediation steps, and a 'start-brief' action that creates a lightweight shift note.
- Maintain accessibility: keyboard focus order, high-contrast badges, and screen-reader labels.

Non-goals: Replace the full incident timeline or replace existing postmortem tooling. This is a navigational/quick-context surface only.

Success metrics:
- Time to first meaningful action for on-call toggled by 25% in lab tests.
- Fewer accidental escalations due to lack of context (tracked via incident follow-ups).

Acceptance criteria:
- Prototype shows a collapsible timeline of up to 6 events in reverse-chron order with type icons, relative timestamps, and severity badges.
- 'Compact handoff' mode has a condensed layout with 44px minimum tap targets, abbreviated text, and a persistent 'Start brief' button.
- Each timeline entry links to the alert detail, and a single persistent Postmortem button opens the postmortem draft (or creates one).
- Keyboard nav and aria labels implemented in the prototype; contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for critical badges.
decisions: Use a stacked card list (max 6) rather than a freeform timeline to save vertical space.
Represent SLO trend as a 3-state micro-pill (OK / Warning / Breach) instead of sparkline to reduce noise in compact mode.
Postmortem button will trigger 'create draft' if none exists and will not auto-publish; this aligns with current content workflow.
Compact handoff uses reduced copy + inline 'cheat sheet' for first responder actions to limit cognitive load.
design_notes: Entry affordances: icon (alert type) + bold title + relative time + severity pill.
Animation: expand/collapse uses 120ms ease-out scale + fade to keep interactions snappy on mobile.
Tap targets: minimum 44x44px for compact mode; spacing collapses from 12px -> 8px when in compact state.
Keyboard: entries reachable with arrow keys; Enter opens detail; 'b' key opens postmortem draft (per accessibility shortcut guidance).
ARIA: role=list for the timeline, role=listitem for entries, aria-labels include 'Alert: <title>, <severity>, <time>.'
